name.message: Muslim Prayer Times: Quran, Adhan, Alarms & Hijri Calendar

description.message: Easily access prayer times and see how much time is left until next prayers.

settingsCodeInfo.message: Settings Code contains all your preferences at the time it was generated, including location, calculation method, custom time offsets, and adhan settings. You can use it to quickly restore your setup on a new device or share it with others. Click on the button to copy it.

calcAngleUpdateNotice.message: The prayer time calculation for your selected method ({method}) has been updated for improved accuracy. Any manual time adjustments (offsets) you had set were reset to 0. Please review your prayer times and re-apply offsets only if you still need them.
calcAngleUpdateNotice.description: One-time notice shown after v2.0.20 when a calculation method's angles changed and manual offsets were reset.

beforeText.description: Nafl alarm timing: before the prayer/night point

afterText.description: Nafl alarm timing: after the prayer/night point

oneThirdText.description: Nafl alarm anchor: one third of the night

twoThirdText.description: Nafl alarm anchor: two thirds of the night

minText.description: Abbreviation for minutes, shown in the nafl-alarm dropdown (e.g. '15 min')

alarmsNoteText.message: Alarms always play, even when adhan calls are off.
alarmsNoteText.description: Note on the alarm page: alarms fire regardless of the adhan on/off setting

noAlarmsText.description: Empty-state text shown on the alarm page when no alarms are set

naflTabText.description: Nafl (voluntary prayer) alarm tab title (shown after a + )
